decline-push-up.criteria: Rigid trunk and straight legs; fixed palms and toes; controlled descent and return. Feet supported on elevated bench.

close-grip-push-up.criteria: Rigid trunk and straight legs; fixed palms and toes; controlled descent and return. Hands inside shoulder width; elbows track backward.

wide-push-up.criteria: Rigid trunk and straight legs; fixed palms and toes; controlled descent and return. Hands wider than shoulders.
